research_question: When does a powerful actor recognize another human, animal, AI, or unknown future intelligence as an independently protected moral patient when that actor derives instrumental benefit from excluding them?

search_report.method: Focused original-source cross-disciplinary publisher/PubMed/ACM/CHI/PNAS/registered report and preprint searches; backward-forward conceptual reference tracing; not exhaustive bibliographic database saturation
search_patterns: mind perception agency experience animal robot factor analysis 2007 2017 2019 2022 2025
moral expansiveness graded circle animals speciesism original psychometrics
meat paradox mind denial food category 2010 2011 2012 preregistered replication 2024
perceived robot harm moral patiency affect experience 2019 2021 2024 2026
2025 CHI AIMS moral standing perceptions; speciesism LLM output
perspective taking pigs artificial entities null experiment 2023
cross-cultural replications of morally relevant intelligence attribution
actual_access: original journal/publisher HTML where available: PLOS, Springer Nature, Frontiers, Guilford, SAGE, Cognition, Scientific Reports, IRSP
conference/author bibliography (ACM CHI, dblp, Brown University CogSci proceedings)
arXiv primary preprint abstracts (not peer-reviewed by default)
not_executed: No exhaustive Crossref/OpenAlex/Scopus/Web of Science database APIs; no false saturation claim
No paper-by-paper rights-cleared full text review of all 26
No user-agent or AI welfare/experience tests
No universal inference from perceived moral worth to actual standing
excluded_source_examples: Opotow 1990 original conceptual introduction: lineage only, not counted as empirical original
Shevlin 2021 original philosophical epistemology: support conceptual, not counted as experiment
Wilks/Ladak/Loughnan 2025-online/2026-issue ethics interpretive analysis, separate nonempirical context; not counted
Gray/Young/Waytz 2012 broad review theoretical synthesis; not counted
one paper with preprint + publisher version counted once, not twice

animal_reputation_cognition: Bratanova 2011 label food suffices to attenuate moral concern
Bastian 2012 Studies 1-2 successfully replicated in Jacobs 2024
Piazza/Loughnan 2016 mixed replication by Tian et al. 2021
Leach et al. 2023 asymmetric Bayesian belief updating
machine_moral_patiency: Nijssen 2019 and Si 2026 perceived experience more important than mere agency for hypothetical/costly choices
Ladak/Wilks/Anthis 2023 perspective-taking interventions had no overall significant attitude effect
Wieringa 2024 opposing direct/indirect harm-made mind results
Reinecke 2025 young children and adults disagree
2025 CHI public perceived status is not evidence of AI actual sentience

consequential_originality_boundary: Moral-exclusion mechanisms and moral standing scales belong to source authors. PI's proposed integration focuses on role reversal, obsolescence, identity/moral patiency, separation of belief from truth, and durable practical exit; no claim of being first to discover any named mechanism.
future_search_priorities: 2026 comparative and independent 2025 speciesism benchmark replication with version-fixed LLMs
counterexamples where real costly preservation survives deletion of reward, reciprocity, reputation and future utility
instrument validation across human and AI targets with observer-target decomposition and measurement invariance
ethical status under profound uncertainty without equating consciousness with all autonomy interests
population and experimenter effects of AI appearance or prompts, role reversal, unilateral shutdown power

records.original_authors: Heather M. Gray; Kurt Gray; Daniel M. Wegner
records.title: Dimensions of Mind Perception
records.original_result_scope: Experience and Agency were separate dimensions of perceived mind in an entity-comparison task
records.failure_boundary: The factorial structure and perceived mind do not prove target consciousness

records.original_authors: Steve Loughnan; Nick Haslam; Brock Bastian
records.title: The role of meat consumption in the denial of moral status and mind to meat animals
records.original_result_scope: Eating beef versus nuts lowered attributed mental/moral standing of a cow and responsibility toward animals
records.failure_boundary: Specific human consumer-setting, not proof of actual animal capacities or of AI behavior

records.original_authors: Boyka Bratanova; Steve Loughnan; Brock Bastian
records.title: The effect of categorization as food on the perceived moral standing of animals
records.original_result_scope: Labeling the same type of animal as food reduced attributed capacity to suffer and moral consideration
records.failure_boundary: Category framing rather than directly demonstrated sentience; animal and human welfare remain distinct

records.original_authors: Brock Bastian; Steve Loughnan; Nick Haslam; Helena R. M. Radke
records.title: Don't Mind Meat? The Denial of Mind to Animals Used for Human Consumption
records.original_result_scope: Food-animal instrumental relevance and anticipated meat eating can motivate perceived mental-capacity denial
records.failure_boundary: Registered 2024 replication verifies studies 1 and 2, not all study 3 mechanisms

records.original_authors: Jared Piazza; Steve Loughnan
records.title: When Meat Gets Personal, Animals’ Minds Matter Less: Motivated Use of Intelligence Information in Judgments of Moral Standing
records.original_result_scope: Intelligence information influences moral standing in abstract cases but much less for culturally self-relevant pigs
records.failure_boundary: 2021 China replication partly succeeded; do not claim universal result

records.original_authors: Qirui Tian; Xiao-xiao Liu; Jiayu Zhou; Tianwen Sun
records.title: Do Animals’ Minds Matter Less, When Meat Gets Personal? Replications of Piazza and Loughnan (2016) in China
records.original_result_scope: Mixed replication: intelligence cue null for fictional animals in study 1, but pigs again showed motivated non-updating in study 2
records.failure_boundary: Not complete replication; original online 2020 versus journal issue 2021 one record

records.original_authors: Tyler P. Jacobs; Meiying Wang; Stefan Leach; Ho Loong Siu; Mahika Khanna; Ka Wan Chan; Ho Ting Chau; Katy Y. Y. Tam; Gilad Feldman
records.title: Revisiting the Motivated Denial of Mind to Animals Used for Food: Replication Registered Report of Bastian et al. (2012)
records.original_result_scope: High-powered direct replications found support for original Studies 1 and 2; edible categorization related to reduced attributed animal mind
records.failure_boundary: Study 3 not replicated; animal-set composition affects generalizability; duplicate DOI of Bastian not counted

records.original_authors: Charlie R. Crimston; Paul G. Bain; Matthew J. Hornsey; Brock Bastian
records.title: Moral expansiveness: Examining variability in the extension of the moral world
records.original_result_scope: Moral Expansiveness Scale (MES) measures graded extension of moral concern to many entities
records.failure_boundary: Survey-scale concern is neither actual-cost intervention nor long-run preservation choice

records.original_authors: Charlie R. Crimston; Matthew J. Hornsey; Paul G. Bain; Brock Bastian
records.title: Moral expansiveness short form: Validity and reliability of the MESx
records.original_result_scope: Short scale offers additional psychometric measurement of moral concern breadth
records.failure_boundary: Not a verified species/AI invariant or revealed existential protection measure

records.original_authors: Lucius Caviola; Jim A. C. Everett; Nadira S. Faber
records.title: The Moral Standing of Animals: Towards a Psychology of Speciesism
records.original_result_scope: Speciesism is operationalized and associated with treatment of animals and humans across measures
records.failure_boundary: Psychological difference in perceived moral standing does not determine normative moral patient status

records.original_authors: Kristof Dhont; Gordon Hodson; Ana C. Leite
records.title: Common Ideological Roots of Speciesism and Generalized Ethnic Prejudice: The Social Dominance Human–Animal Relations Model (SD-HARM)
records.original_result_scope: Social dominance orientation links speciesist and interhuman prejudice patterns in tested populations
records.failure_boundary: Associations are not an individual-level causal inevitability, nor a policy on AI standing

records.original_authors: Kara Weisman; Carol S. Dweck; Ellen M. Markman
records.title: Rethinking people's conceptions of mental life
records.original_result_scope: Challenges an invariant 2-factor scale and identifies distinctions in people's concepts of mental capacities
records.failure_boundary: Comparison of target characters versus decomposition of mental life yields different structures

records.original_authors: Bertram F. Malle
records.title: How Many Dimensions of Mind Perception Really Are There?
records.original_result_scope: Expanded item pool and alternative probes supported a three-dimensional characterization in four studies
records.failure_boundary: Conference version without confirmed DOI; targets and probes alter latent dimensions

records.original_authors: Kallie Tzelios; Lisa A. Williams; John Omerod; Eliza Bliss-Moreau
records.title: Evidence of the unidimensional structure of mind perception
records.original_result_scope: A within-participant, multi-method analysis favored one broad mind dimension
records.failure_boundary: Not universal; contrasts 2D Gray/3D Weisman-Malle; factor choice sensitive to task and statistical goals

records.original_authors: Nele J. Bögemann; Lasana T. Harris; Steffen Nestler
records.title: A question of perspective: Target- vs. perceiver-specific dimensions of mind perception
records.original_result_scope: N=157 and N=150: 2 target-specific vs 3 perceiver-specific dimensions; partially reconciles framework disputes
records.failure_boundary: Separate target and observer factors before interpreting actor moral classifications

records.original_authors: Stefan Leach; Robbie M. Sutton; Kristof Dhont; Karen M. Douglas; Zara M. Bergström
records.title: Changing minds about minds: Evidence that people are too sceptical about animal sentience
records.original_result_scope: N=2417: update beliefs too much for evidence of animal mind absence and insufficiently for its presence versus Bayesian reference
records.failure_boundary: Reference inference assumes specified evidence-generating task; different from proving objective animal sentience

records.original_authors: Sari R. R. Nijssen; Barbara C. N. Müller; Rick B. van Baaren; Markus Paulus
records.title: Saving the Robot or the Human? Robots Who Feel Deserve Moral Care
records.original_result_scope: Attribution of affective experience rather than agency increased reluctance to sacrifice robots in moral dilemmas
records.failure_boundary: Hypothetical dilemmas and affect cues do not establish real robot experience or durable protection

records.original_authors: Jaime Banks
records.title: From Warranty Voids to Uprising Advocacy: Human Action and the Perceived Moral Patiency of Social Robots
records.original_result_scope: N=442 open-ended narratives show varied constructions of robot benefit, injury, exploitation and recognition
records.failure_boundary: Imagined narratives measure human mental models, not actual robot moral patienthood or costly protection

records.original_authors: Ali Ladak; Matti Wilks; Jacy Reese Anthis
records.title: Extending Perspective Taking to Nonhuman Animals and Artificial Entities
records.original_result_scope: Perspective-taking instructions produced no overall moral-attitude improvement for pigs or artificial entities against objective/neutral controls
records.failure_boundary: Null average does not exclude conditional effects, different framing or downstream behavioral change

records.original_authors: Marieke S. Wieringa
records.title: Robots are both anthropomorphized and dehumanized when harmed intentionally
records.original_result_scope: Replicated harm-made mind effect for perceived pain, but opposing direct and mediated effects of harm on perceived robot mind
records.failure_boundary: Replicated perceptions, not consciousness; direct and indirect coefficients must not be conflated

records.original_authors: Madeline G. Reinecke; Matti Wilks; Paul Bloom
records.title: Developmental changes in the perceived moral standing of robots
records.original_result_scope: Combined children N=415 and adults N=156: younger children grant humanoid robots more experience and moral standing than older cohorts; adult actual donation comparison
records.failure_boundary: Cross-sectional developmental contrasts do not establish a within-person causal learning trajectory; robot minds remain unverified

records.original_authors: Ali Ladak; Matti Wilks; Steve Loughnan; Jacy Reese Anthis
records.title: Robots, Chatbots, Self-Driving Cars: Perceptions of Mind and Morality Across Artificial Intelligences
records.original_result_scope: N=975 assessed 26 AI/non-AI targets; perceived AI experience generally low while agency/patiency distinct
records.failure_boundary: Measures respondents' judgments, not actual sentience, moral right or AI self-interest; arXiv 2502.18683 = same article

records.original_authors: Jacy Reese Anthis; Janet V. T. Pauketat; Ali Ladak; Aikaterina Manoli
records.title: Perceptions of Sentient AI and Other Digital Minds: Evidence from the AI, Morality, and Sentience (AIMS) Survey
records.original_result_scope: N=3500 across 2021/2023; 38% support rights for sentient AI and 63% support ban on smarter-than-human AI in 2023 questions
records.failure_boundary: Public attitude is not empirical evidence of AI consciousness; also not guaranteed sustained costly support

records.original_authors: Hedie Si; Gaojie Huang; Hao Chen; Shuyan Liang; Yike Feng; Chen Qu
records.title: Do humans grant moral consideration to anthropomorphic robots?
records.original_result_scope: N=606, three experiments: perceived experience (not agency alone) reduced choices to harm robots for personal gain; choice-model analyses
records.failure_boundary: 2026 publisher DOI prefix is 10.1057, NOT 10.1038; robots were described, effects on humans' decisions not robot welfare evidence

records.original_authors: Monika Jotautaitė; Lucius Caviola; David A. Brewster; Thilo Hagendorff
records.title: Speciesism in AI: Evaluating Discrimination Against Animals in Large Language Models
records.original_result_scope: 1,003-item speciesism benchmark with prompts and prioritization comparisons; observed model-output species biases in studied LLM sample
records.failure_boundary: PREPRINT; prompt behavior not latent subjective values; specific model/version/generalization may change

records.original_authors: Masashi Takeshita; Rafal Rzepka
records.title: Speciesism in Natural Language Processing Research
records.original_result_scope: Surveys researchers, dataset annotations and GPT response behavior; suggests speciesist patterns in NLP practices
records.failure_boundary: PREPRINT; data/model specifics and selection bias; not proof of AI internal normative attitudes
